subject: Re: POC scope rebaseline - add FAQ ingestion use case
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: POC follow-up + next steps (scope, success criteria, timeline)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery + proposed next steps for the POC so we stay aligned: 

Summary of today's call:
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for AcmeCorp's customer support chatbot (intent classification, answer generation) at 95th pct latency <= 250ms and intent accuracy >= 88%.
- Primary datasets: 50k historical support tickets + current canned FAQ doc.
- Stakeholders: Alex (Product), IT Procurement, Camila (AE), Marissa (Sales Eng), Rishi (Sales Lead).

Proposed POC plan (baseline):
- Duration: 6 weeks (kickoff week of Nov 16, demo in week 6).
- Success criteria: latency, accuracy, and throughput targets above.
- Deliverables: test harness, sample integration, evaluation report, and recommended config.

Open items / asks for you:
1) Confirm success criteria above — is intent accuracy 88% the right bar or do you want F1 instead?
2) Can you share the 50k ticket sample link (or allow SFTP access) by next Tue (Nov 17)?
3) Any constraints on data residency or on-prem requirements?

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll send an SOW and ingestion spec for your review by EOD tomorrow.
- Marissa will reach out to schedule a technical kickoff (30–45m).
- If Procurement is needed, loop them in; we can start a DocuSign for the standard POC agreement.

Thanks — want to make this low-friction and fast.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.inference/

Attachments: POC_SOW_v1.pdf (draft)
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, AcmeCorp IT Procurement <it-procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC follow-up + next steps (scope, success criteria, timeline)

Camila — thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick notes: 

- Intent accuracy: F1 would be preferable as it balances precision/recall — can we use F1 >= 0.86 instead of raw accuracy?
- We want to add one more use case to the POC: ingesting the internal FAQ (semi-structured docs) so the bot can surface exact-match answers for product/returns policy. That’s a lighter integration but high business value for support.
- We’ll get the 50k sample to you by EOD Monday (Nov 16).

If adding FAQ ingestion means extending the scope, we’re open to a 1-week extension on the POC to keep evaluation rigorous. Please advise on impact to deliverables and any extra resources needed.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Sr. Product Manager, Customer Experience | AcmeCorp
alex.johnson@acmecorp.com | (212) 555-0198

Subject: Re: POC follow-up + next steps (scope, success criteria, timeline)

Alex —

Appreciate the prompt reply and the F1 preference. We can absolutely switch the success metric to F1 >= 0.86. Regarding the FAQ ingestion use case: good call — that aligns to a measurable win and doesn't require heavy infra changes. Proposed rebaseline below: 

Updated POC scope (rebaseline):
- Added use case: FAQ ingestion (semi-structured docs) for exact-match and retrieval augmentation.
- Timeline: extend POC by 1 week (total 7 weeks). New demo target: week of Dec 28.
- Success criteria (both must be met):
  - Retrieval/FAQ: exact-match precision >= 92% on a 200-item validation set.
  - NLU: intent F1 >= 0.86 on provided ticket sample.
  - Latency: 95th pct <= 300ms when running combined load (intent + retrieval).
- Owners:
  - Redwood: Camila (commercial), Marissa (technical delivery) — Marissa will own ingestion pipeline + eval harness.
  - Acme: Alex (product), IT Procurement (procurement/contract sign-off), assigned Eng lead (TBD) — will need a point-of-contact for SFTP/access and validation labels.

Impact to deliverables / costs:
- No change to commercial pricing for the POC itself; scope extension is within our standard POC model. If we need dedicated infra (e.g., dedicated GPU pool) we’ll notify you and quote separately.
- Deliverables updated: POC_SOW_v2.pdf (attached) and an ingestion_spec.xlsx with sample mapping.

Please confirm: 
1) You accept the 1-week extension and updated success criteria.
2) Who will be the Acme engineering contact for SFTP/access and labeling (name/email).

If you can confirm today, Marissa and I will schedule the tech kickoff for next Tue and finalize the SOW/DocuSign flow.

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Alex / Camila —

Happy to own the ingestion and eval harness. Quick logistics:
- I can run the technical kickoff Tues Nov 17 at 10:00am PT (30–45m). I’ll cover data ingest formats, validation labels, and evaluation steps.
- Need: SFTP credentials or a shared Drive link for the 50k ticket sample + a 200-item FAQ validation set (CSV).
- I’ll prepare a short test plan and an evaluation spreadsheet so we can track F1/precision targets week-over-week.
